summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Reports Tab functionality. All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified all features: Quick Insights (5 standard reports), Saved Reports list, Report Builder, Run Report, Export CSV, Delete Report. Fixed a critical bug where frontend was sending 'null' body in POST requests causing 400 errors.

bug_fixed.issue: Frontend POST requests for runReport and runStandardReport were sending 'null' as body, causing JSON parse error (400 Bad Request)
bug_fixed.fix: Changed 'null' to '{}' (empty object) in axios.post calls for runReport and runStandardReport functions

critical_code_review_comments: All Reports APIs properly implemented: GET list, GET single, POST create, PUT update, DELETE, POST run, GET export, GET runs, GET data-sources, GET standard, POST run-standard
Standard reports include: Registration Funnel, Ticket Sales Breakdown, Revenue Over Time, Attendance & Check-in, Geographic Distribution
Report Builder supports: name, description, category, visualization type (table/bar/line/pie), field selection from 4 data sources, data scope, visibility
Data sources available: Event Data, Ticket Data, Registration Data, Check-in Logs

data-testid attributes properly implemented: reports-dashboard, report-builder, report-viewer, create-report-btn, save-report-btn, report-name-input, viz-type-*, standard-report-*, report-row-*, export-csv-btn, confirm-delete-btn
seed_data_creation: Existing report: 'Registration Overview' (id=1). Test reports created and deleted during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reports Tab is fully functional. APIs tested: GET /events/:eventId/reports (list), GET /events/:eventId/reports/:id (single), POST /events/:eventId/reports (create), PUT /events/:eventId/reports/:id (update), DELETE /events/:eventId/reports/:id (delete), POST /events/:eventId/reports/:id/run (execute), GET /events/:eventId/reports/:id/export (CSV), GET /events/:eventId/reports/:id/runs (history), GET /events/:eventId/reports/data-sources (builder fields), GET /events/:eventId/reports/standard (quick insights), POST /events/:eventId/reports/standard/:id/run (run standard). Frontend displays: Quick Insights section with 5 clickable standard report cards, Saved Reports table with name/type/visualization/visibility/created/actions columns, Report Builder with form fields and field selection checkboxes, Report Viewer with stats and data table, Export dialog, Delete confirmation dialog.
